# netbox_rack_reservation (Resource)

From the [official documentation](https://docs.netbox.dev/en/stable/models/dcim/rackreservation/):

> Users can reserve specific units within a rack for future use. An arbitrary set of units within a rack can be associated with a single reservation, but reservations cannot span multiple racks. A description is required for each reservation, reservations may optionally be associated with a specific tenant.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "netbox_site" "test" {
  name   = "test"
  status = "active"
}

resource "netbox_rack" "test" {
  name     = "test"
  site_id  = netbox_site.test.id
  status   = "active"
  width    = 10
  u_height = 40
}
resource "netbox_rack_reservation" "test" {
  rack_id     = netbox_rack.test.id
  units       = [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
  user_id     = 1
  description = "my description"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `description` (String) A description of the rack reservation.
- `rack_id` (Number) The ID of the rack associated with the rack reservation.
- `units` (Set of Number) The units of the rack reservation.
- `user_id` (Number) The ID of the user associated with the rack reservation.

### Optional

- `comments` (String) Free-form comments about the rack reservation.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the object, as a map of field name to value.
- `owner_id` (Number) The ID of the owner associated with the rack reservation.
- `status` (String) One of [pending, active, stale].
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
- `tenant_id` (Number) The ID of the tenant associated with the rack reservation.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `tags_all` (Set of String) All tags assigned to the object, including those not managed by Terraform.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The ID is the numeric NetBox ID of the object
terraform import netbox_rack_reservation.example 1
```
